description: Plan a re-scaffold of an existing project against the current templates: a three-way diff (baseline vs on-disk vs freshly generated) that separates template changes from the user's own edits, so nothing is clobbered. Reports the plan only — it writes nothing. Requires a generator that supports baseline-upgrade.

config.description: The options it was generated with

directory.description: Path to the existing scaffolded project

preset.description: The preset it was generated from (if any)

name: plan_upgrade
